Synopsys accelerates innovation at automotive OEMs and Tier 1s with silicon to systems design solutions. Synopsys’ automotive solution enables hardware/software co-design to meet E/E, ECU, and SoC architecture requirements and expedites software development to reduce time to market while improving software quality with test automation. In addition, the solution ensures reliability by monitoring and analyzing critical silicon failures in-field throughout silicon lifecycle. Our comprehensive automotive-grade IP, virtual prototyping, design and verification, and silicon lifecycle management technologies help you create safe, secure, reliable, and high-quality software-defined vehicles.

Synopsys provides your team with hardware/software co-design capabilities to optimize SoC and E/E architecture for PPA, safety, reliability, quality, and security. With Synopsys' electronics digital twins (eDT) you can develop and validate each step before production from SoC to ECU to system. Synopsys’ AI-enabled EDA suit, multi-die solution, automotive-grade IP, prototyping technologies, and services will accelerate your team’s development of ISO 26262 functional safety and ISO/SAE 21434 cybersecurity compliant systems. Synopsys experts will guide you to automotive success from early architecture to final delivery of your software-defined vehicles.

Start your software development and testing early, while ensuring high software quality through continuous integration and continuous development (CI/CD) with Synopsys' electronics digital twin solutions. Implement MIL, SIL, PIL, and HIL methodologies to test ECU software and embedded control systems with Synopsys test automation solution. Additionally, Synopsys’ hardware-assisted verification solution helps your teams accelerate software bring-up and testing at every stage of your product lifecycle, from initial exploration to in-field operation.

The Synopsys SLM product family allows OEMs to continuously monitor critical metrics such as silicon voltage, temperature, margins, and health, enhancing the reliability and performance of ECUs, CPUs, GPUs, and architectures. Synopsys SLM products utilize real-time edge and cloud analytics to assess silicon aging and reliability, offering valuable insights into both systemic and random defects within your vehicles and across fleet. It ensures silicon reliability and provides predictive maintenance capabilities, extending silicon lifecycle in field and lowering cost.

Synopsys AI-enabled automotive solutions are transforming how OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers innovate, design, and validate next-generation vehicles from Chip to Code to Cloud with comprehensive silicon-to-system engineering solutions.
Our industry-leading AI Accelerator IP, AI-driven EDA tools, and SLM product family enables faster development of safer and reliable automotive AI systems.
These solutions provide actionable insights into silicon health and performance, helping automotive innovators confidently address the challenges of intelligent, connected mobility.
